title: Semver file versions, upgrade-on-read and format snapshot tests
description: Foundation for Q&A and features (HANDOVER §4 Versioning). Cards, board.json and feature files carry a semver string; missing or integer 1 = 1.0.0. Readers reject newer versions. CLI, bridge and board.html (incl. direct mode) upgrade older files on read, under the lock, and always write the current version. No explicit upgrade command. Old vendored copies fail loudly on touched boards (accepted).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Version parsing/comparison; 1 and missing read as 1.0.0; newer versions rejected loudly
Upgrade-on-read in CLI and bridge (under the lock) and in board.html incl. direct mode; always writes the current version
Upgrade steps are a per-version pipeline so a later major can add a transform
Format snapshot tests: chosen CLI commands on a fixed board compared to verified output and file bytes
README contract and SKILL.md updated (versioning rules, update vendored copies before new code touches a shared board)
bun test passes incl. browser suite

notes: Done 2026-11-01 (commit 82426d2 + d611cdc). Implemented by agents, independently reviewed; live board upgraded via setup + upgrade-on-read.
